en.hubeali: H 14702 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, who has said: Abu Abdullahasws said:

‘You will not be seeing what you would love to (appearance of Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup>) until the Clan of so and so (Clan of Abbas) differing in what is between them. So when they differ, the people would become greedy and the words would be separated, and Al-Sufyani would come out’.
en.sarwar: 254. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, who has said: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said:

‘You will not be seeing what you would love to (appearance of Al-Qaim (a.s.)) until the Clan of so and so (Clan of Abbas) differing in what is between them. So when they differ, the people would become greedy and the words would be separated, and Al-Sufyani would come out’.
